fine_smoothed.moment_cells: exact recipe x tense x voice

method: Use cell-specific observed four-state correctness/completion probabilities. Completed-score influence is C_i(Y_i-P)/mean(C); it includes missing rows. Sum within-cell variances plus twice each aggregate within-family cell-pair covariance. Assign observed coarse residual correlations separately to mixed-Lun and different-nonLun pairs; sweep unobserved repeated-Lun correlation. Expected unstratified sandwich additionally includes squared family mean contributions from the exact grammar allocation and the G/(G-1) correction.
limitations: No final model answers or final membership selected. This is a single input-only aggregate flow witness.
Correlations need not transport across new families, same-tense repetition, class mix or task loads. Repeated-Lun Astra covariance is unidentified.
Fitted fine cell probabilities are sparse and have zero-variance cells; coarse and Dirichlet-smoothed analyses show that sensitivity rather than concealing it.
Bootstrap upper endpoints are separate marginal intervals, not a joint95% confidence region.
Expected sandwich is a scenario, not a promised realization or a replacement for the frozen final analyzer.
Some very-low repeated-Lun rho scenarios are not positive-semidefinite for every potential family block and are flagged, not claimed coherent generative models.
